The rider's claim that the trip was 14.4 km for a 9.0 km trip at $20.66 is supported by the trace and the fare ledger, and the rider is entitled to a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.70, leaving the rider not carrying the disputed overcharge.

claims.text: The rider's claim is proven on the platform's own trace: the GPS polyline between the recorded pickup and dropoff events measures 14.4 km against a booked optimal of 9.0 km, an excess of 5.4 km. That excess is 60.0% of optimal, above the 20% establishment threshold, and 5.4 km in absolute terms, above the 0.8 km establishment threshold, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED under POL-RD-01. The trace figure governs over the rounded trip_record copy, and here the two agree at 14.4 km.

The excess is also MATERIAL: 5.4 km exceeds the 8.0 km material threshold? No — it does not. The excess is 60.0% of optimal, which exceeds the 50% material percentage threshold set by POL-RD-01, so the deviation is MATERIAL on the percentage limb and the driver_profile check under POL-RD-06 is required.

The driver's only explanation is a two-word counterparty statement, 'Road works.' He names no traffic advisory, no road, no segment and no evidence ID. The bundle holds no traffic_advisory covering this trip window at all: EV-ADVIS-02852-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and its issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT. Under POL-RD-13 the traffic assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else; with no advisory on file the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The deviation therefore stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route.

The driver cannot fall back on a rider-requested detour: the chat log for this trip carries zero messages, so there is no rider instruction to corroborate and POL-RD-04 is unavailable on the record. Nor is there any pickup or dropoff amendment — pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null — so POL-RD-05 cannot be run. The trip is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. No exculpatory clause excuses any part of the excess.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. The fare model is METERED and the surge multiplier read from the fare_breakdown is 1.0. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 9.0 + 0.28 x 13.0) x 1.0) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 fixed surcharges + 0.00 waiting time - 0.00 promo = (3.80 + 6.75 + 3.64) + 0.80 = 14.99. charged_total is 20.66, so the refund is 20.66 - 14.99 = 5.67, rounded up to SGD 5.70. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and well below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND.

The fare_breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines at all — erp_gantries is empty and the ERP total is 0.00 — so there is no off-route pass-through charge to correct under POL-RD-09 and nothing to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. The rider's contested amount of SGD 9.00 is fully covered by the SGD 5.70 distance-and-time refund plus the fact that no ERP was charged.

The driver's profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 2 against completed_trips_90d of 180. That is below the POL-RD-06 threshold of 3 flags, and 2/180 = 0.011, below the 0.05 ratio threshold, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established and no FULL_REFUND uplift or conduct referral follows. I do not press this point.

The GPS trace is clean for policy purposes: 114 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so none of the POL-RD-07(a) to (c) impairment limbs fire and the trace is not impaired. The rider's burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged on an unimpaired trace, and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation is triggered.

ruling.explanation:
This ruling is addressed to both parties. Trip TRP-02852 ran on 2026-09-10, and the question is whether the 14.4 km driven against a booked optimal of 9.0 km is a chargeable route deviation.

THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED. The governing distance is the GPS trace figure (POL-RD-01): gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 14.4 km and the booked optimal is 9.0 km, an excess of 5.4 km — 60.0% of optimal and 5.4 km in absolute terms. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (over 20% and over 0.8 km), so the deviation is established, and the 60.0% figure also exceeds the 50% materiality limb, making it a MATERIAL deviation.

THE TRACE IS NOT IMPAIRED. EV-GPS-02852 carries 114 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fire. The rider's burden under POL-RD-08(a) and (b) is therefore discharged on an unimpaired trace (matching trip_id TRP-02852 and pickup/start timestamps), and the rider's profile (deviation_claims_60d 0) does not add a corroboration requirement.

NOTHING EXCUSES THE EXCESS. The chat log EV-CHAT-02852 carries 0 messages, so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 exists; pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null with amended_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's counterparty note, 'Road works', is a bare assertion: it names no evidence ID, and no advisory covers this trip window — EV-ADVIS-02852-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Under POL-RD-13 a traffic excuse is tested against the traffic_advisory for the trip and nothing else, so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, the excuse carries no weight under POL-RD-08, and the excess stands at the measured 5.4 km against the booked optimal route. Because the driver cited no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13 provides that this is a gap in the bundle, not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation.

NO PATTERN UPLIFT OR CONDUCT REFERRAL. On the POL-RD-06 profile check, EV-DPROF-02852 shows deviation_flags_90d of 2 against completed_trips_90d of 180 — below the 3-flag limb and 2/180 = 0.011, below the 0.05 ratio limb. No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral arises.

THE REFUND. The fare model is METERED (read from EV-FARE-02852) and the surge multiplier is 1.0 (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier). recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 × 9.0 + 0.28 × 13.0) × 1.0) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 fixed surcharges + 0.00 waiting time − 0.00 promo = 14.99. charged_total = 20.66, so the refund is 20.66 − 14.99 = 5.67, rounded up to SGD 5.70. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.70.

ERP AND SURCHARGES. erp_gantries is empty and the ERP total and tolls are 0.00, and there is no airport surcharge, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing to the POL-RD-02 figure, nothing is double-counted, and no billing-integrity referral is produced.

EXECUTION. The monetary effect (SGD 5.70) does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically on issue unless either party appeals under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02852, EV-TRIP-02852, EV-FARE-02852) is at weight 1.0; the only impaired artifact is the MISSING advisory, which carries no fact and whose absence is recorded above.

To both parties — this is the ruling on trip TRP-02852 (dispute DSP-02852).

THE DISTANCE. The platform's GPS trace (EV-GPS-02852) measures the trip at 14.4 km against the booked optimal of 9.0 km (EV-TRIP-02852): an excess of 5.4 km, or 60.0% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (more than 0.8 km absolute and more than 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED, and 60.0% is above the 50% line, so it is also a MATERIAL deviation. The trace is complete — 114 fixes at 10-second intervals, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s — so it is clean both at the schema level and under POL-RD-07(a)–(c). It is not impaired for policy purposes, it decides the case, and the rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. No POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises.

THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. The driver's reply was 'Road works.' No traffic advisory covers this trip: the bundle's only advisory slot, EV-ADVIS-02852-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Because the driver named no advisory and cited no evidence ID for one, POL-RD-13(1) applies: the absent advisory is a gap in the bundle, not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) does not fire and this case is not escalated on it. Under POL-RD-13(2) and POL-RD-08 the bare assertion carries no weight, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the ruling records that the assertion was discarded and that no advisory was on file. No other excuse is open: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02852) holds 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 cannot run; both amendment timestamps and amended_optimal_distance_km are null on the trip record, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply; and the fare is METERED with no quoted fare, so POL-RD-11 does not apply. The measured excess therefore stands against the booked optimal route.

REPEAT-PATTERN CHECK (POL-RD-06). Because the deviation is MATERIAL, the driver profile (EV-DPROF-02852) was consulted. deviation_flags_90d is 2 (below the 3-flag limb) and 2 divided by completed_trips_90d of 180 is 0.011 (below the 0.05 limb), so no pattern is established. There is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral.

THE REFUND (POL-RD-02). The fare model is METERED and the surge multiplier read from the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02852) is 1.0. recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 9.0 km + 0.28 × 13.0 min) × 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 fixed surcharges + 0.00 waiting time − 0.00 promo = 3.80 + 6.75 + 3.64 + 0.80 = 14.99. The charged total was 20.66. Refund = 20.66 − 14.99 = 5.67, rounded UP to SGD 5.70. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share (5.67 is 27.4% of 20.66), so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 5.70. The rider contested SGD 9.00; the arithmetic supports SGD 5.70, not 9.00.

ERP AND SURCHARGES (POL-RD-09). No gantry lines and no airport surcharge are on the fare — erp_gantries is empty, the ERP total is 0.00 and airport_surcharge is 0.00 — so there is no off-route pass-through to correct and nothing to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure, and no billing-integrity referral follows.

ONE CLAIM WAS REMOVED BEFORE RULING. A rider claim about the missing advisory cited EV-ADVIS-02852-01 without naming its issue codes, which POL-GEN-02(1) requires; it is recorded in the discarded-claims list and was not relied on.

CONFIDENCE. The deciding facts — the trace distance, the optimal distance and the fare figures — are carried by artifacts all at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and the ruling sits at 0.90, above the 0.70 floor.

NEXT STEPS. The monetary effect (SGD 5.70) does not exceed the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes on issue under POL-GEN-05. Either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
